name: usage-pacer
description: Lets Claude read your plan usage (5h / 7-day limits), context fill and session cost, wind down before a limit, and hand off to a fresh agent before the context fills.

handoffAt.title: Hand off at context %
handoffAt.description: When the context window reaches this percentage, Claude writes a handoff and a fresh agent continues in the same session. 0 turns it off.
